name: ShenZhen Click Technology Co.,LTD.
summary: ShenZhen Click Technology Co.,LTD. manufactures and sells magnetic components and power solutions. The company provides power transformers and switching power supply transformers; solar inverter inductors, high-power inverter inductors, PFC inductors, filters, rectifier inductors, resonant inductors, output inductors, and surface mount inductors; power adapters, power battery chargers; and power battery chargers, power adapters, network communication power supplies, smart home power supplies, and industrial and instrumentation power supplies. ShenZhen Click Technology Co.,LTD. was founded in 1995 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
